rows.en: 1. Which of the following statements about the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MSP) is FALSE? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 1. MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) सम्बन्धी निम्न कथनहरूमध्ये कुन गलत छ? एउटा उत्तरमा मात्र चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 1. Which of the following statements about the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MSP) is incorrect? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. The MSP includes organizational activities such as establishing systems for staff care, as well as programmatic activities.
rows.ne: a. MSP मा कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिका साथै कर्मचारीको हेरचाहका लागि प्रणाली स्थापना गर्ने जस्ता संस्थागत गतिविधि समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: a. The MSP includes programmatic activities as well as institutional activities such as establishing systems for staff care.

rows.en: b. The MSP is designed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies that require a coordinated response
rows.ne: b. समन्वित प्रतिकार्य आवश्यक पर्ने सबै प्रकारका मानवीय आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा प्रयोग गर्न MSP तयार गरिएको हो।
rows.bt: b. The MSP was developed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies requiring a coordinated response.

rows.en: c. The MSP is a resource for donors and programme planners
rows.ne: c. MSP दातृ निकाय र कार्यक्रम योजनाकारका लागि एक स्रोत हो।
rows.bt: c. The MSP is a resource for donor agencies and programme planners.

rows.en: d. The MSP is a comprehensive list of all possible MHPSS activities that may be implemented in emergencies.
rows.ne: d. MSP आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा कार्यान्वयन गर्न सकिने सबै सम्भावित MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको विस्तृत सूची हो।
rows.bt: d. The MSP is a comprehensive list of all possible MHPSS activities that can be implemented in an emergency.

rows.en: e. No single organization is expected to implement all MSP activities.
rows.ne: e. कुनै एक संस्थाले सबै MSP गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिँदैन।
rows.bt: e. No single organization is expected to implement all MSP activities.

rows.en: 2. Which of the following tools are included in the MSP? Mark all the answers that apply.
rows.ne: 2. निम्नमध्ये कुन उपकरणहरू MSP मा समावेश छन्? लागू हुने सबै उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 2. Which of the following tools are included in the MSP? Mark all answers that apply.

rows.en: a. Checklists of actions for implementing each MSP activity
rows.ne: a. प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधि कार्यान्वयनका लागि कार्यहरूको जाँचसूचीहरू
rows.bt: a. Checklists of tasks for implementing each MSP activity
rows.note: The Nepali adds an obligation, reflected in the BT as actions that 'must be carried out'; the source only describes checklists of actions for implementation. Removed the added mandatory wording.

rows.en: b. Lists of budget items for consideration for each activity
rows.ne: b. प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि विचारार्थ बजेट शीर्षकहरूको सूचीहरू
rows.bt: b. Lists of budget headings for consideration for each activity
rows.note: The Nepali changes plural lists to a single list and uses wording requiring consideration rather than simply offering items for consideration. Restored plural lists and removed the added obligation. The BT changes budget items to budget headings, referring to category labels rather than the items themselves.

rows.en: c. Lists of donors interested in funding each activity
rows.ne: c. प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि वित्तपोषण गर्न रुचि भएका दातृ निकायका सूचीहरू
rows.bt: c. Lists of donor agencies interested in providing funding for each activity
rows.note: The BT changes donors interested in funding to donors willing to fund, suggesting greater commitment, and changes plural lists to a single list. Restored interest and plural lists. The BT narrows donors to donor agencies, excluding individual donors and other donors that are not agencies.

rows.en: d. Guidance on using the MSP in Public Health Emergencies
rows.ne: d. जनस्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा MSP प्रयोग गर्ने मार्गदर्शन
rows.bt: d. Guidance on using the MSP in public health emergencies

rows.en: e. Gap Analysis tool
rows.ne: e. अन्तर विश्लेषण उपकरण
rows.bt: e. Gap analysis tool

rows.en: 3. Which of the following is NOT an activity in the MSP? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 3. निम्नमध्ये कुन MSP मा समावेश गतिविधि होइन? एउटा उत्तरमा मात्र चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 3. Which of the following is not an activity included in the MSP? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: a. क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने
rows.bt: a. Coordinate MHPSS within a sector and between sectors
rows.note: Reuses the supplied activity-label candidate verbatim.

rows.en: b. Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: b. सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: b. Providing mental health services as part of general health services
rows.note: Drafted as an ordinary workshop quiz answer option, not a clinical instrument item. The activity label reuses T107, as in FAC-22-0190.

rows.en: c. Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: c. मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने
rows.bt: c. Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed T100 activity-label candidate verbatim; clinical review remains pending.

rows.en: d. Provide psychological debriefing to first responders
rows.ne: d. प्रारम्भिक प्रतिकार्यमा खटिने व्यक्तिहरूलाई [psychological debriefing] प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: d. Provide [psychological debriefing] to people deployed in the initial response
rows.note: Drafted as an ordinary workshop quiz answer option, matching FAC-22-0192. The intervention name stays in English in brackets; no Nepali term for it has been agreed yet.

rows.en: e. Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: e. शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने
rows.bt: e. Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education sector staff and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.note: Reuses the cited unreviewed T105 activity-label candidate verbatim; clinical review remains pending.

rows.en: 4. Which of the following is NOT included in the MSP (including the online platform)? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 4. निम्नमध्ये कुन MSP मा (अनलाइन मञ्चसहित) समावेश छैन? एउटा उत्तरमा मात्र चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 4. Which of the following is not included in the MSP (including the online platform)? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. MHPSS activities as part of health, protection and education sectors
rows.ne: a. स्वास्थ्य, संरक्षण र शिक्षा क्षेत्रका अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: a. MHPSS activities as part of the health, protection and education sectors

rows.en: b. Key considerations on complex issues relating to MHPSS implementation
rows.ne: b. MHPSS कार्यान्वयनसँग सम्बन्धित जटिल विषयहरूबारे मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: b. Key considerations regarding complex issues related to MHPSS implementation

rows.en: c. Clinical guidance on how to assess and manage priority mental health conditions
rows.ne: c. प्राथमिकतामा रहेका मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूको मूल्याङ्कन र व्यवस्थापन कसरी गर्ने भन्ने चिकित्सकीय मार्गदर्शन।
rows.bt: c. Clinical guidance on how to assess and manage mental health-related conditions that are priorities.
rows.note: The draft preserves both assessment and management and the qualification that the conditions are priorities.

rows.en: d. Pre-recorded orientations and video guides
rows.ne: d. पहिले नै रेकर्ड गरिएका अभिमुखीकरण र भिडियो मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: d. Pre-recorded orientations and video guides

rows.en: e. Lists of resources on MHPSS for at-risk groups
rows.ne: e. जोखिममा रहेका समूहहरूका लागि MHPSS सम्बन्धी स्रोतहरूका सूची
rows.bt: e. Lists of resources related to MHPSS for at-risk groups

rows.en: 5. Which of the following is NOT an intended use of the MSP? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 5. तलका मध्ये कुनचाहिँ MSP को अभिप्रेत प्रयोग होइन? एउटा उत्तरमा मात्र चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 5. Which of the following is not an intended use of the MSP? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. To advocate for MHPSS needs and activities
rows.ne: a. MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकता र गतिविधिहरूका लागि पैरवी गर्न
rows.bt: a. To advocate for MHPSS-related needs and activities
rows.note: Recurring term absent from the supplied glossary: advocacy / advocate; proposed wording: पैरवी / पैरवी गर्ने.

rows.en: b. To identify and address gaps in the MHPSS response
rows.ne: b. MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा रहेका कमीहरू पहिचान गर्न र तिनलाई सम्बोधन गर्न
rows.bt: b. To identify gaps in the MHPSS response and address them

rows.en: c. To audit activities for compliance with minimum standards
rows.ne: c. न्यूनतम मापदण्डहरू पालना भए वा नभएको निर्धारण गर्न गतिविधिहरूको अडिट गर्न
rows.bt: c. To audit activities to determine whether or not minimum standards have been complied with
rows.note: Audit is retained as an examination of compliance, not recast as routine monitoring. The translation describes generic testing rather than the specific audit function named in the source. The revision explicitly retains audit; its technical terminology remains pending review.

rows.en: d. To estimate costs and develop budgets
rows.ne: d. लागत अनुमान गर्न र बजेट तयार गर्न
rows.bt: d. To estimate costs and prepare a budget

rows.en: e. To find guidance on how to implement individual MHPSS activities
rows.ne: e. प्रत्येक MHPSS गतिविधि कसरी कार्यान्वयन गर्ने भन्ने मार्गदर्शन पाउन
rows.bt: e. To obtain guidance on how to implement each MHPSS activity
rows.note: Individual refers to each activity, not to activities delivered to an individual person.

rows.en: Please circle the correct answer(s) for the following multiple-choice questions.
rows.ne: कृपया निम्न बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्नहरूका सही उत्तरहरूमा गोलो घेरा लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Please circle the correct answers to the following multiple-choice questions.

rows.en: 1. Which of the following statements about the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MSP) is FALSE? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 1. MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) सम्बन्धी निम्न कथनहरूमध्ये कुन गलत छ? एउटा मात्र उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 1. Which of the following statements about the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MSP) is incorrect? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. The MSP includes organizational activities such as establishing systems for staff care, as well as programmatic activities.
rows.ne: a. MSP मा कर्मचारीको हेरचाहका लागि प्रणाली स्थापना गर्नेजस्ता संस्थागत गतिविधिका साथै कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधि पनि समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: a. The MSP includes institutional activities, such as establishing systems for staff care, as well as programmatic activities.

rows.en: b. The MSP is designed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies that require a coordinated response
rows.ne: b. समन्वित प्रतिकार्य आवश्यक पर्ने सबै प्रकारका मानवीय आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा प्रयोग गर्न MSP तयार गरिएको हो।
rows.bt: b. The MSP has been developed for use in all types of humanitarian emergencies requiring a coordinated response.

rows.en: c. The MSP is a resource for donors and programme planners
rows.ne: c. MSP दातृ निकाय र कार्यक्रम योजनाकारका लागि एउटा स्रोत हो।
rows.bt: c. The MSP is a resource for donor agencies and programme planners.

rows.en: d. The MSP is a comprehensive list of all possible MHPSS activities that may be implemented in emergencies.
rows.ne: d. MSP आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा कार्यान्वयन गर्न सकिने सबै सम्भावित MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको विस्तृत सूची हो।
rows.bt: d. The MSP is a comprehensive list of all possible MHPSS activities that can be implemented in emergencies.

rows.en: e. No single organization is expected to implement all MSP activities.
rows.ne: e. कुनै एउटा संस्थाले नै सबै MSP गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छैन।
rows.bt: e. No single organization is expected to implement all MSP activities on its own.

rows.en: 2. Which of the following tools are included in the MSP? Mark all the answers that apply.
rows.ne: 2. निम्नमध्ये कुन-कुन उपकरण MSP मा समावेश छन्? लागू हुने सबै उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 2. Which of the following tools are included in the MSP? Mark all answers that apply.

rows.en: a. Checklists of actions for implementing each MSP activity
rows.ne: a. प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधि कार्यान्वयन गर्नका लागि गर्नुपर्ने कार्यका जाँचसूचीहरू
rows.bt: a. Checklists of tasks to be done to implement each MSP activity

rows.en: b. Lists of budget items for consideration for each activity
rows.ne: b. प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि विचार गर्नुपर्ने बजेट शीर्षकहरूको सूची
rows.bt: b. A list of budget headings to consider for each activity

rows.en: c. Lists of donors interested in funding each activity
rows.ne: c. प्रत्येक गतिविधिका लागि वित्तपोषण गर्न इच्छुक दातृ निकायको सूची
rows.bt: c. A list of donor agencies willing to fund each activity

rows.en: d. Guidance on using the MSP in Public Health Emergencies
rows.ne: d. जनस्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा MSP प्रयोग गर्नेबारे मार्गदर्शन
rows.bt: d. Guidance on using the MSP in public health emergencies

rows.en: e. Gap Analysis tool
rows.ne: e. अन्तर विश्लेषण उपकरण
rows.bt: e. Gap analysis tool

rows.en: 3. Which of the following is NOT an activity in the MSP? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 3. निम्नमध्ये कुन MSP मा समावेश गतिविधि होइन? एउटा मात्र उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 3. Which of the following is not an activity included in the MSP? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: a. क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने
rows.bt: a. Coordinating MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.note: Activity label reused verbatim from the supplied unreviewed candidate.

rows.en: b. Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: b. सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने
rows.bt: b. Providing mental health services as part of general health services
rows.note: Preserve the source clinical meaning, qualifications, conditions and any negative instruction; specialist human translation is required. Activity label reused verbatim from T107, a cited unreviewed prior candidate; clinical review remains pending.

rows.en: c. Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: c. मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने
rows.bt: c. Disseminating key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.note: Activity label reused verbatim from T100, a cited unreviewed prior candidate; clinical review remains pending.

rows.en: d. Provide psychological debriefing to first responders
rows.ne: d. प्रारम्भिक प्रतिकार्यमा खटिने व्यक्तिहरूलाई [psychological debriefing] प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: d. Provide [psychological debriefing] to people deployed in the initial response.
rows.note: The exact English name preserves the specific psychological intervention rather than a general operational debriefing; no correctness judgment is added.

rows.en: e. Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: e. शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: e. Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education sector personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Reuses the exact activity-label candidate T105, including its existing unreviewed clinical wording; no validation is claimed.

rows.en: 4. Which of the following is NOT included in the MSP (including the online platform)? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 4. निम्नमध्ये कुन कुरा MSP (अनलाइन प्लेटफर्मसहित) मा समावेश गरिएको छैन? एउटा मात्र उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 4. Which of the following is not included in the MSP (including the online platform)? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. MHPSS activities as part of health, protection and education sectors
rows.ne: a. स्वास्थ्य, संरक्षण र शिक्षा क्षेत्रका अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: a. MHPSS activities as components of the health, protection and education sectors

rows.en: b. Key considerations on complex issues relating to MHPSS implementation
rows.ne: b. MHPSS कार्यान्वयनसँग सम्बन्धित जटिल विषयहरूबारे मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: b. Key considerations regarding complex issues related to MHPSS implementation
rows.note: Implementation recurs but has no supplied glossary entry. Proposed technical wording: कार्यान्वयन; the frozen glossary is unchanged.

rows.en: c. Clinical guidance on how to assess and manage priority mental health conditions
rows.ne: c. प्राथमिकतामा रहेका मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्थाहरूको मूल्याङ्कन र व्यवस्थापन कसरी गर्ने भन्ने चिकित्सकीय मार्गदर्शन।
rows.bt: c. Clinical guidance on how to assess and manage mental health-related conditions that are priorities.
rows.note: The draft retains clinical guidance, assessment, management and the priority qualification without narrowing the conditions to named diagnoses.

rows.en: d. Pre-recorded orientations and video guides
rows.ne: d. पहिल्यै रेकर्ड गरिएका अभिमुखीकरण र भिडियो मार्गदर्शिकाहरू
rows.bt: d. Pre-recorded orientations and video guides

rows.en: e. Lists of resources on MHPSS for at-risk groups
rows.ne: e. जोखिममा रहेका समूहहरूका लागि MHPSS सम्बन्धी स्रोतहरूको सूचीहरू
rows.bt: e. Lists of resources related to MHPSS for groups at risk

rows.en: 5. Which of the following is NOT an intended use of the MSP? Mark only one answer.
rows.ne: 5. निम्नमध्ये कुन कुरा MSP को अभिप्रेत प्रयोग होइन? एउटा मात्र उत्तरमा चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: 5. Which of the following is not an intended use of the MSP? Mark only one answer.

rows.en: a. To advocate for MHPSS needs and activities
rows.ne: a. MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकता र गतिविधिहरूका लागि पैरवी गर्न
rows.bt: a. To advocate for MHPSS-related needs and activities

rows.en: b. To identify and address gaps in the MHPSS response
rows.ne: b. MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा रहेका कमीहरू पहिचान गरी सम्बोधन गर्न
rows.bt: b. To identify and address gaps in the MHPSS response

rows.en: c. To audit activities for compliance with minimum standards
rows.ne: c. न्यूनतम मापदण्डहरू पालना भए–नभएको जाँच गर्न गतिविधिहरूको लेखापरीक्षण गर्न
rows.bt: c. To audit activities to check whether minimum standards have been followed or not

rows.en: d. To estimate costs and develop budgets
rows.ne: d. लागत अनुमान गर्न र बजेट तयार गर्न
rows.bt: d. To estimate costs and prepare a budget

rows.en: e. To find guidance on how to implement individual MHPSS activities
rows.ne: e. अलगअलग MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कसरी कार्यान्वयन गर्ने भन्ने मार्गदर्शन पाउन
rows.bt: e. To obtain guidance on how to implement individual MHPSS activities
rows.note: Uses कार्यान्वयन for the recurring implementation concept; this technical wording is proposed separately and does not amend the frozen glossary.
